svg.title: PMF Sub-goal #1 Layered View — WHO Models

a.title: Periodic olling budget forecasts produced on schedule (Outcome)
Budget execution reports with actionable insights (by program, geography, facility) (Outcome)
Provider payment schedules generated on time (linked to releases) (Outcome)
National/Unified Health Accounts published on schedule (Outcome)
Health revenue collection monitoring reports (where relevant to PFM oversight) (Outcome)
Budget planning, execution and oversight (monitoring): Ensure health budgets are planned, executed and monitored to support efficient budget execution, transparency and providers paid on time. (Goal)

text.tspan: Budget planning, execution and oversight (monitoring): Ensure health
budgets are planned, executed and monitored to support efficient budget
execution, transparency and providers paid on time.

a.title: Health budget planning & forecasting (ability to produce rolling forecasts and budget scenarios) (Capability)
Budget execution management (ability to allocate, release, commit, and track spending) (Capability)
Financial performance monitoring & disclosure (ability to monitor execution and publish accountable views) (Capability)
Code & master-data management (ability to standardize and manage financial classifications) (Capability)
Unified Health Accounts (ability to compile and report standardized national health accounts) (Capability)
Data ingestion, aggregation, and normalization (Application Service)
Master data and code system management (Application Service)
Budget forecasting and scenario modelling (Application Service)
Budget approval, workflow routing and controls (Application Service)
Analytical systems to analyse data (Application Service)
Health finance infromation system/ Data lake / warehouse with ETL/ELT pipelines (Application Component)
